title: WPMS/2927/2013 of Ram Mahesh Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No.2927 of 2013
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, Advocate, present
for the petitioner.
Mr. Paresh Tripathi, learned Standing
Counsel, present for the State/respondent
nos. 1, 2 & 4 to 6.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate, present for
the respondent no.3.
Petitioner resides in Village Durgapur in
District Udham Singh Nagar and relying upon
some G.O. dated 27.12.2012. Case of the
petitioner is that his village is liable to be
declared as a separate Village Panchayat.
Petitioner also submits that this is also the
demand of all the villagers. His further
contention is that such a representation is
pending with the District Magistrate, Udham
Singh Nagar.
In view of the above, this writ petition is
disposed of with the direction to the District
Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar that if such a
representation is pending or is now filed
before him, and in case delimitation exercise
has not completed already, the representation
shall be decided in accordance with law as
early as possible.
